steps.js: () => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')).filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; }).map(t => { const label = Array.from(t.querySelectorAll('div')).find(d => d.children.length === 0 && (d.textContent||'').trim()); return { flik: t.getAttribute('aria-label'), färg: label ? getComputedStyle(label).color : null, ikonFärg: getComputedStyle(t.querySelector('svg') || t).color }; })
